name: dsh-chat-deepseek
description: Embedded DeepSeek Chat for the dsh web GUI. Host half runs a local same-origin reverse proxy in front of chat.deepseek.com (strips the frame-ancestors CSP, rewrites static assets, rebinds cookies) so the site can render inside an iframe; browser half registers a real GUI panel (sidebar.panellist row + main slot) and keeps one warm iframe over the centre column. Log in once, then it stays logged in.
